The downstream code then proceeds with booking creation as if all destinations succeeded. judged_text: In createAllCalendarEvents, when a destination's credentialId resolves to nothing (not in this.calendarCredentials, not found in DB, or `credentialFromDB.app?.slug` is falsy) the destination is silently skipped — no log, no error, and no failed EventResult pushed to createdEvents The booking is created and reported successful while the calendar event for that destination is never created; for legacy credentials without an app relation the new DB-fetch fallback (added precisely to fix this) still drops the event invisibly, so users discover missing calendar entries only after the meeting is a no-show on that calendar

record.issue_text: [BUG] In createAllCalendarEvents, when a destination's credentialId resolves to nothing (not in this.calendarCredentials, not found in DB, or `credentialFromDB.app?.slug` is falsy) the destination is silently skipped — no log, no error, and no failed EventResult pushed to createdEvents The booking is created and reported successful while the calendar event for that destination is never created; for legacy credentials without an app relation the new DB-fetch fallback (added precisely to fix this) still drops the event invisibly, so users discover missing calendar entries only after the meeting is a no-show on that calendar

adjudication.rationale: In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, the new loop over `event.destinationCalendar` only pushes a result when a `credential` is resolved and `createEvent(...)` runs. If `destination.credentialId` is set but the credential is not found in `this.calendarCredentials`, and the DB fallback (`prisma.credential.findUnique`) returns null or returns a row where `credentialFromDB.app?.slug` is falsy, then `credential` remains undefined and the code falls through without logging and without pushing a failed `EventResult` (it simply skips that destination). This behavior is visible in the `if (credential) { ... createdEvents.push(...) }` block with no corresponding `else` handling for the unresolved-credential case.
